newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Curative Health rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Curative Health rated buy.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth said Monday it began coverage of Curative Health Services Inc with a buy rating and an 18 to 24 month price target of $37 a share.
-- Shares of Curative Health, which manages a network of clinics that specialize in chronic wounds and skin ulcers, were up 1/4 at 23-1/2.
-- Dain said it based its price targets on earnings estimates of $0.81 a share for 1997 and $1.07 for 1998.

--"During 1995 and 1995, the company remade itself from a 'biopharmaceutical' story to a 'care center' story, ending its (research and development) expenses and embarking on a network expansion plan," Dain said in a report.
-- From a current network of over 100 wound care centers, the company intends to increase its market penetration, Dain added.
